lessons.text: Strip whitespace and normalise case before parsing.

versions.critique: Splitting on a single space breaks on tabs and extra spaces; lines with too few fields crash instead of returning None.
Level is upper-cased but timestamps with a 'T' separator are not handled; consider one anchored regex.

versions.code:
import re


def parse_log_line(line):
    m = re.match(r"^(\S+)\s+(\S+)\s+([A-Za-z]+)\s+(.*)$", line.strip())
    return {"level": m[3].upper(), "message": m[4]} if m else None
